The main takeaway from our work is that

change agents should not only be cognizant of the organizational culture and the organizational rhetoric, but they should also consider the influence of organizational opinion leaders in the diffusion process.

change agents should be able to recognize the organizational barriers to innovation adoption and use that knowledge to craft persuasive messages that are more likely to lead to the adoption of an innovative practice.
change agents must be cognizant of the organizational discourse that may be used to justify resistance to an innovation and must be ready to address those justifications with counter-arguments.
